title: BBC Easy English: daily routine, part 2

lines.text: What do you do every day?
I wake up, I eat breakfast, I have a shower,
I walk to work, I listen to music,
I eat lunch, I go home and watch a film.
I eat dinner. Then I read a book and go to sleep.
I wake up, I have a shower, I eat breakfast,
I get the train to work. I read the news on the train.
I eat lunch. After I finish work, I do some exercise.
I eat dinner and then I go to sleep.
What about you? What do you do every day?
What do you eat for breakfast, Tim?
I eat fruit and yogurt for breakfast.
